베트남.ex: 이번 겨울에 베트남으로 여행을 가려고 해요.
베트남.x: I'm planning to travel to Vietnam this winter.

합격.ex: 합격 소식을 듣고 가족들이 정말 기뻐했어요.
합격.x: My family was really happy to hear the news that I passed.

아버님.ex: 친구 아버님은 요즘도 건강하게 잘 지내세요?
아버님.x: Is your friend's father still doing well and healthy these days?
아버님.t: Use for someone else's father or your father-in-law; for your own dad, 아버지 or 아빠 is normal.

생각나다.m: to come to mind, to remember, to be reminded of
생각나다.x: When I hear this song, I think of my hometown.
생각나다.e: 생각 (thought) + 나다 (to come out) = a thought pops up on its own.
생각나다.t: The thing remembered is the subject: 이름이 생각 안 나요 = I can't remember the name. Pronounced [생강나다].

걱정되다.m: to be worried, to feel anxious
걱정되다.ex: 내일 있을 면접이 너무 걱정돼서 잠이 안 와요.
걱정되다.x: I'm so worried about tomorrow's interview that I can't sleep.
걱정되다.e: 걱정 'worry' + 되다; 걱정 is a native word, not Sino-Korean.
걱정되다.t: 걱정돼요 is 'I'm worried'; 걱정하지 마세요 is the usual 'Don't worry.'

남.ex: 남의 말을 너무 신경 쓰지 마세요.
남.x: Don't worry too much about what others say.
남.e: Homonym warning: 남 also means 'south' and 'male'; context tells which.

대체로.ex: 이 지역은 여름에 대체로 덥고 습해요.
대체로.x: This region is generally hot and humid in the summer.
대체로.e: Literally 'by the main body', so on the whole.

묶다.m: to tie, to bind, to tie up
묶다.x: My hair is long, so I always tie it back.
묶다.t: 묶다 and 묵다 'to stay at lodging' sound identical, [묵따]; spelling and context tell them apart.

뺨.x: The child's cheeks turned red in the cold weather.
뺨.e: Synonym of 볼; 뺨을 때리다 means 'to slap someone's face'.
뺨.t: 볼 is softer and common for cute cheeks; 뺨 often appears with slapping.

집중.ex: 옆이 너무 시끄러워서 공부에 집중이 안 돼요.
집중.x: It's so noisy next to me that I can't focus on studying.
집중.t: Pronounced [집쭝]; 집중이 안 되다 is the natural way to say 'I can't concentrate.'

캐리어.ex: 캐리어에 짐을 다 넣었는데 안 닫혀요.
캐리어.x: I put all my stuff in the suitcase, but it won't close.
캐리어.e: Konglish from English 'carrier'; English speakers say 'suitcase' or 'rolling luggage'.
캐리어.t: A cabin-size suitcase is 기내용 캐리어.

계좌 이체.ex: 현금이 없으시면 계좌 이체로 보내 주셔도 돼요.
계좌 이체.x: If you don't have cash, you can send it by bank transfer.
계좌 이체.e: 계좌 'bank account' (literally 'counting place') + 이체 'transfer' (literally 'move and swap').
계좌 이체.t: Transfers between Korean banks are fast and usually free in banking apps, so friends split bills and many small shops accept payment this way. Verb: 이체하다.

교수님.x: I emailed my professor a question.
교수님.t: Always add -님 when talking to or about your professor, and use 께 instead of 에게.

작품성.ex: 그 영화는 흥행은 못 했지만 작품성은 인정받았어요.
작품성.x: That movie wasn't a box-office hit, but its artistic merit was recognized.
작품성.t: Often contrasted with 흥행 or 대중성: 작품성은 좋은데 흥행은 실패했다.

즐거움.ex: 요리하는 즐거움을 알게 된 후 매일 집에서 밥을 해요.
즐거움.x: Ever since I discovered the joy of cooking, I make meals at home every day.
즐거움.e: Noun from 즐겁다 (to be fun); the ㅂ becomes 우.
즐거움.t: 기쁨 is joy from good news; 즐거움 is the fun of an activity, like 여행의 즐거움.

기대감.ex: 새 학기를 앞두고 기대감이 커지고 있어요.
기대감.x: With the new semester ahead, my excitement is growing.

메우다.m: to fill (a hole, gap); to make up for (a shortfall)
메우다.x: We hired a new employee to fill the empty position.
메우다.e: Causative of 메다 'to be clogged', as in 목이 메다 'to choke up'.

정당하다.ex: 일한 만큼 정당한 대가를 받아야 해요.
정당하다.x: You should get fair pay for the work you do.
정당하다.t: Don't confuse with 정당 'political party' (政黨), a different word with the same sound.

기립 박수.ex: 공연이 끝나자 관객들이 기립 박수를 보냈어요.
기립 박수.x: When the show ended, the audience gave a standing ovation.
기립 박수.t: Pronounced [기립빡쑤]. Give one is 기립 박수를 치다/보내다; get one is 기립 박수를 받다.

검은띠.ex: 삼 년 만에 드디어 검은띠를 땄어요.
검은띠.x: After three years, I finally earned my black belt.
검은띠.t: You 'earn' one with 따다: 검은띠를 따다. Black-belt ranks are counted in 단 (1단, 2단…); children under 15 get a half red, half black 품띠 instead.

국정.m: state affairs, national administration, running the country
국정.x: The president is the one responsible for running the country.
국정.t: 국정 감사 (국감 for short) is the National Assembly's annual audit of government agencies.

세계화.ex: 세계화로 인해 나라 사이의 교류가 많아졌습니다.
세계화.x: Because of globalization, exchanges between countries have increased.
세계화.t: Pronounced [세게화]; ㅖ after a consonant often sounds like ㅔ.

전세난.ex: 서울의 전세난 때문에 많은 사람이 경기도로 이사했어요.
전세난.x: Because of Seoul's jeonse shortage, many people moved to Gyeonggi Province.
전세난.t: 전세 means paying a large deposit instead of monthly rent, refunded when you move out.

덕망.m: moral standing, respect earned through virtue
덕망.ex: 그 교수님은 학생들 사이에서 덕망이 높으세요.
덕망.x: That professor is highly respected among students for his virtue.
덕망.t: Pronounced [덩망] — nasalization; 덕망이 높다 = to be widely respected.

전과자.m: ex-convict, person with a criminal record
전과자.ex: 전과자라는 이유로 취업이 어려운 경우가 많아요.
전과자.x: It's often hard to get a job just because you have a criminal record.
전과자.e: Literally 'person with a previous penalty'; 전과 alone means 'criminal record'.
전과자.t: Counting records: 전과 3범 means 'a three-time convict'.

혼합경제.ex: 오늘날 대부분의 나라는 혼합경제를 채택하고 있습니다.
혼합경제.x: Most countries today have adopted a mixed economy.
혼합경제.e: 혼합 'mixture' + 경제 'economy' — markets plus government planning.

외적 동기.forms: 외적 동기가 되다 · 외적 동기를 주다
외적 동기.ex: 돈이나 칭찬 같은 보상은 외적 동기에 해당합니다.
외적 동기.x: Rewards like money or praise count as extrinsic motivation.

협심증.ex: 계단을 오를 때 가슴이 아프면 협심증을 의심해 봐야 해요.
협심증.x: If your chest hurts when climbing stairs, you should suspect angina.
협심증.e: Literally 'narrow-heart condition' — the heart's vessels narrow.

중앙값.ex: 소득은 평균보다 중앙값을 보는 것이 더 정확해요.
중앙값.x: For income, looking at the median is more accurate than the mean.
중앙값.t: Pronounced [중앙깝]; 값 after a noun gets a tensed sound, as in 최빈값 [최빈깝].

박사과정.x: He is pursuing a doctoral program in the US.
박사과정.t: Use the collocation 박사과정을 밟다 (to pursue a doctoral program); a PhD student is 박사과정생.

유체역학.x: Airplane wings are designed using fluid mechanics.
유체역학.t: -체 = state of matter: 고체 (solid), 액체 (liquid), 기체 (gas), 유체 (fluid).

전지적 작가 시점.forms: 전지적 작가 시점으로 쓰다 · 전지적 작가 시점의 소설
전지적 작가 시점.ex: 전지적 작가 시점에서는 서술자가 인물의 속마음까지 알려 줘요.
전지적 작가 시점.x: In the omniscient point of view, the narrator even tells us the characters' inner thoughts.
전지적 작가 시점.e: Literally 'all-knowing writer viewpoint' — the narrator knows every character's thoughts.
전지적 작가 시점.t: Pronounced [전지적 작까 시쩜]; one of the four 시점 types taught in Korean schools.

관찰자.ex: 이 소설에서 나는 사건을 지켜보는 관찰자일 뿐이에요.
관찰자.x: In this novel, 'I' am just an observer watching the events.
관찰자.e: Literally 'one who views and examines'; 관찰자 시점 = observer point of view.
관찰자.t: Pronounced [관찰짜] — the ㅈ after ㄹ is tensed.

청소년비행.ex: 청소년비행을 막기 위해 학교와 가정이 함께 노력해야 합니다.
청소년비행.x: Schools and families must work together to prevent juvenile delinquency.
청소년비행.e: 비행 here means 'wrongful conduct', literally 'not-proper deeds'.
청소년비행.t: Don't confuse this 비행 'misconduct' with 비행 'flight', as in 비행기.

주간지.ex: 그 사건은 한 시사 주간지가 처음 보도했어요.
주간지.x: That incident was first reported by a weekly current-affairs magazine.
